contexts.text: The natural things of (this new Church) are described by Tubal-Cain.

Zillah bare Tubal-Cain, the instructor of every artificer of brass and iron; and the sister of Tubal-Cain was Naamah (). Zillah = the mother of the natural things of this new Church; Tubal-Cain the instructor... = the doctrine of natural good and truth...; the sister of Tubal-Cain = a like Church, or doctrine of natural good and truth outside this Church.
Why Tubal-Cain is called the instructor, and not the father.
That from these there were natural good and truth, is signified by Tubal-Cain, whom Zillah bare.
